title: A Radiators for the Interior
author: Gideon Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Ishikawa, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
